name: Multi-polygenic score (MPS)
model_likelihood: Regression of one outcome on multiple polygenic scores; no explicit outcome sampling distribution stated
prior: Elastic-net L1/L2 penalty on score coefficients; input SNP weights constructed using LDpred
inference_algorithm: LDpred score construction followed by cross-validated elastic-net fitting and final model selection
estimand: Predicted phenotype; coefficients ranking score contributions; R2
data_input: Discovery GWAS summary statistics plus target individual genotypes and training outcomes
tunable_settings: alpha; lambda; ten folds; 100 repeated partitions

name: Elastic net score regression
model_likelihood: Linear regression of outcomes on polygenic predictors
prior: Combined L1 and L2 regularization for selection and continuous shrinkage
inference_algorithm: Tune alpha and lambda by repeated ten-fold cross-validation; select the best performing model
estimand: Regression coefficients and explained variance R2
data_input: Multiple polygenic scores and training outcomes
tunable_settings: alpha; lambda; ten folds; 100 repeated partitions
